memories.content: The colleagues are nurses who can see the swap channel. Some may be interested in picking up an extra shift for pay or flexibility, but none have a prior commitment to take this shift.

The ward has a swap channel where nurses can post shift exchange requests. The rota locks on Friday at 15:00, after which no changes are possible. Karolina's post is visible to all colleagues in the channel.
